subject.title: [Feature]: Standardize skill data directory convention (configPaths) under ~/.openclaw/

question: Should OpenClaw define a durable per-skill runtime data contract in core, or should this remain ClawHub authoring guidance/plugin-owned storage?
rationale: The requested behavior creates new durable filesystem or metadata/API semantics for community skills, and repository policy treats config/storage and plugin API surfaces as maintainer product decisions.

options.title: Define a core skill data contract
options.body: Add a maintained metadata/API and docs path for per-skill writable data under the OpenClaw state directory, with migration and security expectations.

options.title: Keep it as ClawHub guidance
options.body: Document and enforce the convention through skill publishing review without adding runtime directory creation or placeholders in core.

options.title: Defer pending storage design
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose between filesystem, SQLite/plugin KV, or bundle-style authoring rules.

recommendation.title: Defer pending storage design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose between filesystem, SQLite/plugin KV, or bundle-style authoring rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skill docs/runtime work plus repository-level product direction make this the best available routing candidate from the inspected history.
